page.overview:
Who is Nomaskible?

Nolan Grayson (father) Debbie Grayson (mother)

Nomaskible is is a supporting antagonist in Invincible, debuting from Season 3. He is an evil variant of main Invincible from another universe.

Nomaskible was assembled by Angstrom Levy to start the Invincible War in the mainstream dimension. After the war, he and the surviving variants turned on Angstrom for breaking their deal and were subsequently banished to the Wasteland Universe.

Nomaskible has nearly identical physique to his original counterpart. He is tall, fair-skinned, has black hair that’s thick but styled and has brown eyes too.
